source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Filter は 受けるダメージを軽減する、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する。

source.name: Light Screen
source.originalDescription: Mr. Mime creates a wall that prevents enemies from passing. If an enemy is near the location where the wall is created, they are shoved and left unable to act for 0.5s. Create a wall of light in the designated area that prevents enemies from passing.

source.name: Showtime
source.originalDescription: Mr. Mime leaps forward and begins a performance; stunning enemies for 0.5s, dealing damage in a large area around him 4 times, and becomes unstoppable for the duration. The final hit deals double damage and stuns enemies for 1s. Jump to the designated location and start a pantomime performance, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act for a short time. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Showtime は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。
